description: Appendix A of the phase-3 units spec: the closed list of structural parameter names, which may be positional and are not quantities. Built from the spec's seed list and the maps' struct entries (source: 'seed', a decision Dnn or a map section M1-M3). Adding a name needs a reviewer note in the commit body. A name with a scope is structural only in callables defined in those modules. 'mesher, pending' (D12) applies only to galerkin.mesh and galerkin.mesh3d. The keys of the registry-named prescribed_* mappings are tags; the names themselves are registry names, so none is listed. tol and sigma are not structural. An entry added after L1 commit 1b carries a reviewer_note (also in its commit body); an entry of 'deferred to the materials step' names the closing condition that ends it.

entries.name: evaluate
entries.note: a callable (ConductivityModel field)

entries.name: derivative
entries.note: a callable (ConductivityModel field)

entries.name: exact
entries.note: the callable of postprocess.l2_error

entries.name: mass
entries.note: a matrix

entries.name: stiffness
entries.note: a matrix

entries.name: source
entries.note: the mesher output from_mesher reads (galerkin.interop); the citation text of a physmat Material or Property, a str passed through unread
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3 widens the scope to physmat: Material(source) and Property(source) are the record citation that spec section 4.2 keeps as Material.source. One entry per name, so the category stays object; the materials step keeps source in the record (design 5.8).

entries.name: V
entries.note: a nodal field in postprocess; the normalized frequency in refsol.fiber

entries.name: t
entries.note: the design-parameter step of MeshMotion

entries.name: temperature_range
entries.note: ConductivityModel field

entries.name: last_temperature
entries.note: JouleConvergenceError's last iterate

entries.name: mode_a
entries.unit_token_note: a pair label (mode_a, mode_b), not the ampere

entries.name: modes_a
entries.unit_token_note: a pair label (modes_a, modes_b), not the ampere
entries.note: the WaveguideModes of the solve that carries mode_a
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11b: spec 4.3 gives cross_power(modes_a, mode_a, modes_b, mode_b) and field_overlap with these names; the result objects of two solves, as modes is, not quantities.

entries.name: modes_b
entries.note: the WaveguideModes of the solve that carries mode_b
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11b: as modes_a.

entries.name: node_set
entries.note: the node ids of EdgeSpace.boundary_edge_ids(node_set) and EdgeSpace3D.boundary_edge_ids(node_set): the boundary edges with both ends in it
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11: the edge spaces stay public structural types (map M2 3.4) while the em kernels leave the top level; their one method takes node indices, as pec_nodes and fixed_nodes do; ids, not a quantity.

entries.name: terms
entries.note: a series term count; the search text of physmat.rii.Database.search

entries.name: maximum_terms
entries.note: the most series terms a slab temperature may sum before it refuses
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 6: ConvectiveSlab and FluxSlab.temperature(points, *, time, relative_tolerance, maximum_terms) keep their term cap; a count, not a quantity (iteration_limit means iterations).

entries.name: time_index
entries.note: the index of a requested time, as time_indices
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 6: TransientHeatStepError(time_index, *, time) keeps the failing step index beside its time in s; an index into the requested times.

entries.name: reason
entries.note: the failure message
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 7: JouleConvergenceError(reason, history, *, temperature) keeps its message text first (simcase saves it, D27); text, not a quantity.

entries.name: history
entries.note: the completed iteration records (JouleIteration), in order
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 7: JouleConvergenceError(reason, history, *, temperature) and TemperatureJouleHeatResult.history hold the JouleIteration records simcase saves (D27); records, not a quantity.

entries.name: coupled
entries.note: the SteadyJouleHeatResult at the returned temperature
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 7: TemperatureJouleHeatResult.coupled holds the result object, as electrical and thermal do on SteadyJouleHeatResult.

entries.name: xp
entries.note: the array namespace (NumPy, JAX or PyTorch) of a checked motion
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: D21 keeps shape.MotionStep(*, xp, t, design_velocity, moved) and live_triangle_geometry(xp, mesh, triangles, step) public for solver modules; xp is the namespace object, not a quantity.

entries.name: moved
entries.note: the moved NumPy mesh of a MotionStep
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: MotionStep.moved holds the Mesh at the step t (D21 keeps MotionStep public); a mesh object, not a quantity.

entries.name: step
entries.note: the MotionStep that live_triangle_geometry reads
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: live_triangle_geometry(xp, mesh, triangles, step) takes the MotionStep motion_step returns (D21 keeps both public); an object, not a quantity.

entries.name: error
entries.note: the callable that builds a stage's exception from (stage, exc, **context)
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: OneWayChain(error) of the public galerkin.coupling (Appendix C); a callable, not a quantity.

entries.name: context
entries.note: the keyword context OneWayChain.stage hands its error unchanged (the workflows pass time_index and time)
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: OneWayChain.stage(name, **context) passes its keywords through to the caller's error; the workflows' keys are time_index and the registry name time, renamed from time_s in this commit (M1 1.15).

entries.name: location
entries.note: where a Field's values live: "node" or "element" (coupling.LOCATIONS)
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: Field(mesh, values, *, location, unit, name=None) of the public galerkin.coupling; a name from a closed list, not a quantity.

entries.name: message
entries.note: the text of a refusal: WorkflowStageError's message, the ValueError of Field.on_mesh and transfer
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: WorkflowStageError(stage, message), Field.on_mesh(mesh, *, regions=True, message=...) and transfer(field, mesh, *, regions=True, message=...) keep their message text; text, not a quantity.

entries.name: stage
entries.note: the name of a workflow stage (input, heat, transfer, mechanics, manifest)
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: WorkflowStageError(stage, message) and TransientThermoelasticError(stage, *, time_index=None, time=None) keep the failing stage's name first; text, not a quantity.

entries.name: known
entries.note: the (N,) boolean mask of the nodes whose velocity extend_velocity keeps
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: extend_velocity(mesh, values, known, *, method) beside values (positional data); a node mask, not a quantity.

entries.name: steps
entries.note: the stored TransientThermoelasticStep records, in selection order
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: TransientThermoelasticResult.steps holds one record per selected time (time_index, time, temperature_snapshot, mechanics); records, not a quantity.

entries.name: mesh_hash
entries.note: the framed FNV-1a64 identifier of a snapshot's coordinates and connectivity ("fnv1a64:...")
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: TemperatureSnapshot keeps its three identifiers, whose framing bytes are unchanged; text, not a quantity (P3-11 field clause).

entries.name: temperature_hash
entries.note: the framed FNV-1a64 identifier of a snapshot's nodal temperatures
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: as mesh_hash.

entries.name: snapshot_hash
entries.note: the framed FNV-1a64 identifier of the whole snapshot (schema, units, mesh and temperature identifiers)
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: as mesh_hash.

entries.name: schema_version
entries.note: the snapshot record's version (1)
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: TemperatureSnapshot.schema_version stays 1: its hashed bytes are unchanged; a version number, not a quantity.

entries.name: units
entries.note: a snapshot's read-only map from field to SI unit, {"nodes": "m", "temperature": "K"}
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 8: replaces TemperatureSnapshot's length_unit and temperature_unit fields; verify_snapshot still checks it. A field here because the snapshot is a frozen record; results expose .units as a property.

entries.name: branch
entries.note: which of two solutions: joule_slab's "lower" or "upper" steady state of a folding current-voltage curve, lossy_slab's "decay" or "outgoing" square-root sheet
entries.reviewer_note: L2 commit 7: current_driven(..., branch="lower") picks one of two steady states below the fold current; a name from a closed list, not a quantity. lossy_slab.exterior_root(..., branch) takes one of BRANCHES the same way, so its allowlist entry goes too.

entries.name: branches
entries.note: the pair of square-root sheets (left, right exterior), each "decay" or "outgoing" (lossy_slab.BRANCHES)
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11c: lossy_slab's characteristic, residual, solve, continued_root and field take the sheets of the two half-spaces as one pair (D38), as exterior_root takes one branch; names from a closed list, not a quantity.

entries.name: dps
entries.note: mpmath's working precision in decimal digits (default 40)
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11c: bent_slab's Bessel matching runs in mpmath at dps decimal digits; a precision setting, not a quantity.

entries.name: polarization
entries.note: which member (0 or 1) of a degenerate +-l pair vector_mode_field returns: the angular phase p = 0 or pi/2
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11d: fiber.vector_mode_field keeps polarization (0 or 1, default 0), an index into the degenerate pair of a hybrid mode; not a quantity, and no registry name fits (mode_index counts modes, not the members of a pair).

entries.name: n_max
entries.note: the largest mode index per axis of a closed-form enumeration (m, n <= n_max)
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11e: rect_waveguide_cutoffs(*, box_size, n_max=5, include_tm=False) keeps its enumeration bound, a count beside l_max and m_max (spec 4.1: counts are on Appendix A; M3 1.2 'count'); rect_cavity_resonances uses the same name, so its allowlist entry for n_max leaves with this one.

entries.name: include_tm
entries.note: also list the TM cutoffs (the 2D curl-curl problem returns the TE set)
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11e: rect_waveguide_cutoffs' switch for the TM family; a flag, not a quantity.

entries.name: pec_sides
entries.note: the sides of Hadley's unit square that carry PEC, as galerkin rectangle_mesh boundary tags
entries.reviewer_note: L3 commit 11e: a field of the DielectricCorner record (P3-11's field names), not a parameter: the record is a result class built by dielectric_corners(); tag names, not a quantity.

entries.name: convection
entries.note: {tag: (heat transfer coefficient, ambient temperature)}

entries.name: physical
entries.note: physical group tags by name

entries.name: optical
entries.note: the optical model of a physmat Material: a physmat.kernels model built by a *_model constructor, the library or physmat.rii
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: Material(optical) holds the kernel object; its methods take micrometres and are internal, and Material.refractive_index and relative_permittivity are its SI surface.

entries.name: metal
entries.note: the metal of metal_thermal_conductivity: "Cu", "Al" or "W", exact
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: D43 gives metal_thermal_conductivity(metal, *, temperature, residual_resistivity_ratio) with metal positional; a name from a closed list, not a quantity.

entries.name: properties
entries.note: a physmat Material's mapping of today's property keys (density, specific_heat, thermal_expansion, thermo_optic_dn_dT, ...) to Property records
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: D35 and spec 1.2 keep the library's property keys in this step; Material.property(key, *, temperature) reads them.
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 gives the record its registry property names and at/quality fields (design 5.8).

entries.name: aliases
entries.note: other names of a library record (text); physmat.material matches names exactly and never uses them
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: kept as record data, as spec 13 lists Material(aliases); simcase's did-you-mean and tools/units_batch/convert_v02.py fold names and aliases themselves.
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 decides the record format (design 5.8 has no aliases) and removes or keeps them with their two readers.

entries.name: datum_temperature
entries.note: the temperature in K at which a record's optical source states its data
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: spec 1.2 keeps Material.datum_* unchanged in this step (spec 13 names this category).
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 replaces it with the record's at.

entries.name: datum_assumed
entries.note: a flag: the record's source states no temperature (I-DATUM-ASSUMED in simcase)
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: spec 1.2 keeps Material.datum_* unchanged in this step; simcase reads it.
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 replaces it with the record's at and quality.

entries.name: value
entries.note: a physmat Property's constant or callable of temperature in K
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: spec 13 keeps Property(value, unit, source); Property(temperature=...) evaluates it.
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 replaces Property with the record's value or model, unit, at, valid, source and quality.

entries.name: unit
entries.note: a physmat Property's unit string ("-" for poisson_ratio); the SI unit text a galerkin.coupling Field carries ("K", "W/m^3"), recorded and never compared
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: spec 1.2 keeps the unit "-" and today's unit strings in this step. L2 commit 8 widens the scope to galerkin.coupling: Field(mesh, values, *, location, unit, name=None) keeps its unit text, because spec 1.2 (F4) defers a compared quantity= to an additive later commit. One entry per name, so the category stays this one; its closing condition is physmat's, and Field's unit stays until that F4 commit.
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 gives each property its registry name and canonical unit ("1" for "-").

entries.name: valid_vacuum_wavelength
entries.note: the (low, high) validity range in m of sellmeier_model (low None for an open bound), the name of Material.valid_vacuum_wavelength
entries.reviewer_note: L1 commit 3: sellmeier_model takes the range a document writes as valid.vacuum_wavelength under the attribute name of spec 4.2; a range of a model, not a quantity value.
entries.closing: decision order-format-library item 3: the materials step after 0.0.2 gives model records the document's valid form (design 5.2), which replaces it.
